## Summary

Describe the problem and the change in a few sentences.

## Product Impact

- [ ] User-facing interface or interaction
- [ ] Product claim or evidence boundary
- [ ] Embedded documentation
- [ ] Media asset
- [ ] Build, test, or repository maintenance only

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run vercel-build`
- [ ] Desktop layout checked
- [ ] Mobile layout checked
- [ ] Relevant Markdown documents open in the in-site reader

## Evidence Review

- [ ] New or changed claims are supported by a versioned source document.
- [ ] Prototype limitations remain clear.
- [ ] No credentials, worker data, or private material are included.

## Screenshots

Add before-and-after screenshots for visible changes.
